title: You can’t drive people on an empty tank. ⛽️🛑
paragraphs: You can’t drive people on an empty tank. ⛽️🛑
"A person who feels appreciated will always do more than what is expected."

Criticism creates compliance. Appreciation creates passion. If you constantly critique without encouraging, don't be surprised when people do the bare minimum to survive. But if you value them, they will go to war for you.

Jesus didn't just command His disciples; He washed their feet. He called them friends. He valued them. If you want a team, a spouse, or a child to go the extra mile, make sure you are noticing the first mile they walked.
📖 "Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing." — 1 Thessalonians 5:11
